maps.title: Col de Bavella
maps.pitch: The Col de Bavella and the D268 hairpins climbing to it from both sides, under the granite towers of the Aiguilles de Bavella. Built from 0.5 m LiDAR.

images.caption: The Aiguilles de Bavella from the col

maps.title: Fjallabak
maps.pitch: The offroad map: Landmannalaugar's rhyolite mountains, the Laugahraun lava and the crater lakes, and the F208 Fjallabaksleið east through the ford-cut Jökuldalir valleys to Eldgjá. 230 km of gravel F-road and track and dozens of river fords, on 26.62 km of highland. Built from 2 m ArcticDEM.

images.caption: A ford on the way through the highlands

maps.title: Hardknott Pass
maps.pitch: Hardknott and Wrynose in the Lake District: England's steepest single-track fell roads, barely a car wide at up to 31 %, over the passes between Eskdale and Little Langdale, with 106 km of fell tracks round them, driven on the left. Built from 1 m Environment Agency LiDAR.

images.caption: The hairpins on Hardknott's east side
Hardknott's east climb from the air
A walled lane in Little Langdale

maps.title: Jeju
maps.pitch: A 33 km window on Jeju's volcanic heart: both roads over Hallasan's shoulder, the 1100 Road to the highland at 1,100 m and the 516 Road through the Seongpanak forest, from Jeju City down to Seogwipo. Three hill climbs and a four-stage rally, with the coast at both ends.

maps.title: Kent Group
maps.pitch: Deal, Erith and Dover, three granite islands in Bass Strait halfway between Victoria and Tasmania, in one map. A single real track climbs from the old station to the Deal Island light, 280 m above the sea; everything else is offroad, with a real seabed round the islands.

images.caption: Deal, Erith and Dover from the air
The track near the top of the light climb

maps.title: Lake Kinneret
maps.pitch: The whole lake and the road around it, with the far shore always in view across the water. 32.77 km square: you can start where the lake is still hidden and watch it appear as you drive down.

images.caption: The ring road on the shore
An overpass in the Galilee hills

maps.title: Masca
maps.pitch: The Teno massif at Tenerife's north-west corner: the TF-436 hairpins over the ridge and down through Masca village, the Masca gorge running to the sea, and the tracks of the Teno Alto plateau. Built from 2 m LiDAR.

images.caption: Masca and its gorge from the air
The climb to the Cherfe pass

maps.title: Naxos
maps.pitch: The largest of the Cyclades, coast to summit. Dry hills, stone villages, salt pans, and roads that crest a saddle to open onto the sea.

images.caption: The salt pans on the south-west coast
A stone bench above the sea

maps.title: Ouessant
maps.pitch: The westernmost island of Brittany: narrow lanes, cliffs and reefs, with a real seabed from 1 m land-and-sea LiDAR.

images.caption: The road to the Stiff lighthouse

maps.title: The Small Crater
maps.pitch: HaMakhtesh HaKatan, the small erosion crater of the northern Negev. Layered walls around a gravel floor, rock formations, baja courses and rally stages. Offroading country.

images.caption: A flag on the rim trail
A drivable rock arch on the floor
A gravel track into the crater

maps.title: Thasos
maps.pitch: The whole island: pine forest, mountain villages, a coast road all the way round, rally stages and an autosport park. Mount Athos stands on the horizon, 55 km away across the sea.

images.caption: Mount Athos from the south-west coast
A chapel beside a mountain road
A road through the olive groves

maps.title: Tremola
maps.pitch: The Tremola, the cobbled old Gotthard pass road, its hairpins stacked up the Val Tremola from Airolo to the hospice. Built from swisstopo's 0.5 m terrain model.

images.caption: The hairpins of the Val Tremola
Cobbled hairpins stacked on the slope
The Leventina valley below the pass

maps.title: Trollstigen
maps.pitch: Trollstigen and Romsdalen in western Norway: the eleven hairpins of the Fv63 up the Trollstigen wall from Isterdalen, and the E136 along Romsdalen under the Trollveggen face down to Åndalsnes and the fjord. Built from Kartverket's 1 m LiDAR.

images.caption: The Trollstigen hairpins from the air
The E136 under the Romsdal peaks

maps.title: Col de Turini
maps.pitch: The Col de Turini in the Alpes-Maritimes: the hairpin climbs from La Bollène-Vésubie and Moulinet over the col, the road on to Peira-Cava and the Authion loop above it, with 321 km of mountain tracks between them. Built from IGN LiDAR HD.

images.caption: Looking across the valleys from a viewpoint
High road with the coast beyond

candidates.title: El Hierro
candidates.note: Volcanic escarpments and a harbour for gymkhana.

candidates.title: Yakushima
candidates.note: Ancient cedar forest and a ring road.

candidates.title: Isle of Arran
candidates.note: Scotland in miniature, with a road around the coast.

candidates.title: Groix
candidates.note: A small Breton island with a real seabed.

candidates.title: Ile d'Yeu
candidates.note: A small Atlantic island built from 0.5 m LiDAR.
